3	import { z } from 'zod'

8	// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
9	
10	type ActionResult = { error?: string }
11	
12	/** Privacy levels for progress photos */
13	export type PhotoPrivacy = 'studio' | 'client' | 'public'
14	
15	type ReadRole = 'owner' | 'admin' | 'artist' | 'receptionist' | 'guest_artist'
16	
17	function canWrite(role: ReadRole): boolean {
18	  return role === 'owner' || role === 'admin' || role === 'artist'
19	}
20	
21	// ─── Zod schemas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
22	
23	const updateCaptionSchema = z.object({
24	  photoId: z.string().uuid('photoId must be a valid UUID'),
25	  caption: z.string().max(500, 'Caption cannot exceed 500 characters'),
26	})

28	const deletePhotoSchema = z.object({
29	  photoId: z.string().uuid('photoId must be a valid UUID'),

32	const setPrivacySchema = z.object({
33	  photoId: z.string().uuid('photoId must be a valid UUID'),
34	  privacy: z.enum(['studio', 'client', 'public'] as const),
35	})

37	// ─── Helper: resolve projectId from photoId (scoped to studio) ────────────────
38	
39	async function resolvePhoto(
40	  supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>,
41	  photoId: string,
42	  studioId: string
43	): Promise<{ projectId: string; createdBy: string | null } | null> {
44	  // Join through projects to enforce studio scope
45	  const { data } = await supabase
46	    .from('project_progress_photos')
47	    .select('id, project_id, created_by, project:projects!inner(studio_id)')
48	    .eq('id', photoId)
49	    .maybeSingle()
50	
51	  if (!data) return null
52	
53	  // Type-narrow the joined project row
54	  const row = data as unknown as {
55	    id: string
56	    project_id: string
57	    created_by: string | null
58	    project: { studio_id: string }
59	  }
60	
61	  if (row.project.studio_id !== studioId) return null
62	
63	  return { projectId: row.project_id, createdBy: row.created_by }
64	}
65	
66	// ─── updateProjectPhotoCaptionAction ─────────────────────────────────────────
67	
68	/**
69	 * Update the caption on a single progress photo.
70	 * Role: studio member with write access (owner | admin | artist).
71	 */
72	export async function updateProjectPhotoCaptionAction({
73	  photoId,
74	  caption,
75	}: {
76	  photoId: string
77	  caption: string
78	}): Promise<ActionResult> {
79	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
80	  if (!auth) return { error: 'Not authenticated' }
81	  if (!canWrite(auth.role as ReadRole)) return { error: 'Insufficient permissions' }
82	
83	  const parsed = updateCaptionSchema.safeParse({ photoId, caption })
84	  if (!parsed.success) {
85	    return { error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Validation failed' }
86	  }
87	
88	  const supabase = await createClient()
89	
90	  const resolved = await resolvePhoto(supabase, parsed.data.photoId, auth.studioId)
91	  if (!resolved) return { error: 'Photo not found' }
92	
93	  const { error: updateError } = await supabase
94	    .from('project_progress_photos')
95	    .update({ caption: parsed.data.caption })
96	    .eq('id', parsed.data.photoId)
97	
98	  if (updateError) {
99	    logger.error({ updateError, photoId }, 'updateProjectPhotoCaptionAction failed')
100	    return { error: 'Failed to update caption' }
101	  }
102	
103	  revalidatePath(`/projects/${resolved.projectId}`)
104	  return {}
105	}
106	
107	// ─── deleteProjectPhotoAction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
108	
109	/**
110	 * Delete a progress photo.
111	 * Role: the uploader OR owner/admin.
112	 */
113	export async function deleteProjectPhotoAction({
114	  photoId,
115	}: {
116	  photoId: string
117	}): Promise<ActionResult> {
118	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
119	  if (!auth) return { error: 'Not authenticated' }
120	
121	  const parsed = deletePhotoSchema.safeParse({ photoId })
122	  if (!parsed.success) {
123	    return { error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Validation failed' }
124	  }
125	
126	  const supabase = await createClient()
127	
128	  const resolved = await resolvePhoto(supabase, parsed.data.photoId, auth.studioId)
129	  if (!resolved) return { error: 'Photo not found' }
130	
131	  // Permission: uploader always can; owner/admin always can; others cannot
132	  const isUploader = resolved.createdBy === auth.user.id
133	  const isAdminOrOwner = auth.role === 'owner' || auth.role === 'admin'
134	  if (!isUploader && !isAdminOrOwner) {
135	    return { error: 'You do not have permission to delete this photo' }
136	  }
137	
138	  // Fetch storage_path before deletion for cleanup
139	  const { data: photoData } = await supabase
140	    .from('project_progress_photos')
141	    .select('storage_path')
142	    .eq('id', parsed.data.photoId)
143	    .maybeSingle()
144	
145	  const { error: deleteError } = await supabase
146	    .from('project_progress_photos')
147	    .delete()
148	    .eq('id', parsed.data.photoId)
149	
150	  if (deleteError) {
151	    logger.error({ deleteError, photoId }, 'deleteProjectPhotoAction failed')
152	    return { error: 'Failed to delete photo' }
153	  }
154	
155	  // Best-effort storage cleanup using service-role client
156	  if (photoData?.storage_path) {
157	    const { createServiceRoleClient } = await import('@/lib/supabase/server')
158	    const srClient = createServiceRoleClient()
159	    await srClient.storage
160	      .from('project-photos')
161	      .remove([photoData.storage_path])
162	      .catch(() => undefined)
163	  }
164	
165	  revalidatePath(`/projects/${resolved.projectId}`)
166	  return {}
167	}
168

170	
171	/**
172	 * Set the privacy level on a single progress photo.
173	 * privacy: 'studio' | 'client' | 'public'
174	 * Default on upload: 'studio'.
175	 * Role: studio member with write access (owner | admin | artist).
176	 */
177	export async function setPhotoPrivacyAction({
178	  photoId,
179	  privacy,
180	}: {
181	  photoId: string
182	  privacy: PhotoPrivacy
183	}): Promise<ActionResult> {
184	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
185	  if (!auth) return { error: 'Not authenticated' }
186	  if (!canWrite(auth.role as ReadRole)) return { error: 'Insufficient permissions' }
187	
188	  const parsed = setPrivacySchema.safeParse({ photoId, privacy })
189	  if (!parsed.success) {
190	    return { error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Validation failed' }
191	  }
192	
193	  const supabase = await createClient()
194	
195	  const resolved = await resolvePhoto(supabase, parsed.data.photoId, auth.studioId)
196	  if (!resolved) return { error: 'Photo not found' }
197	
198	  const { error: updateError } = await supabase
199	    .from('project_progress_photos')
200	    .update({ privacy: parsed.data.privacy })
201	    .eq('id', parsed.data.photoId)
202	
203	  if (updateError) {
204	    logger.error({ updateError, photoId }, 'setPhotoPrivacyAction failed')
205	    return { error: 'Failed to update privacy setting' }
206	  }
207	
208	  revalidatePath(`/projects/${resolved.projectId}`)
209	  return {}
210	}

3	 *
4	 * Runs daily at 03:15 UTC.

6	 * PUBLIC revoked) which stamps `stalled_at = now()` on projects that have
7	 * been in planning/deposit_paid status for 45+ days without activity.
8	 *
9	 * Returns an int — the count of projects newly flagged as stalled.
10	 *
11	 * Requires the service-role client (RPC is revoked from PUBLIC).

13	import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase.js'
14	import { logger } from '../lib/logger.js'

16	// ─── Main handler ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
17	
18	export async function runProjectStalledDetector(): Promise<void> {
19	  const start = Date.now()
20	  const runLog = logger.child({ job: 'project-stalled-detector' })
21	
22	  runLog.info('project-stalled-detector: calling mark_stalled_projects RPC')
23	
24	  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('mark_stalled_projects')
25	
26	  if (error) {
27	    runLog.error(
28	      { err: error, duration_ms: Date.now() - start },
29	      'project-stalled-detector: RPC failed',
30	    )
31	    // Exit non-zero so Railway marks the run as failed and fires an alert.
32	    process.exitCode = 1
33	    return
34	  }
35	
36	  const count_flagged = typeof data === 'number' ? data : 0
37	  runLog.info(
38	    { job: 'project-stalled-detector', count_flagged, duration_ms: Date.now() - start },
39	    'project-stalled-detector: complete',
40	  )
